verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side UI framework distributed as a JavaScript library. It exposes no hosted HTTP API, so an OpenAPI-style service spec is a category error for this product type, and the probe confirms no OpenAPI paths exist. The /llms.txt documentation bundle is machine-readable docs, not an API spec, and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
